contentPattern.structure: full-bleed background image + gradient overlay + single centered heading

suitableFor: simple full-width banner headers with a single centered title
blog/listing/section landing banners over a background photo
pages needing an image banner with no CTAs or checklist
notSuitableFor: partner/solution heroes with highlighted headline, checklist and badge (use hero-partner)
text-only light-background heroes with body copy and buttons
